note: Which format of translation file a client reads. No table of versions: every client released before this rule says nothing and reads the format 1; from it on, each client says what it reads (X-UGT-Format, or ?format= on a stream), and the site does not list, announce or serve a translation beyond it.

in.value: string or null: the header's (or the parameter's) value

announced.out: int: the format the client reads

cases.why: 🔴 every mod and Manager released before this rule says nothing and reads the format 1 — the whole reason no table is needed
an empty header is no announcement
what the client says it reads
a header value may carry the spaces of its transport
an unreadable claim is read as no claim: the format every client reads, never a format nobody does
nothing reads less than 1 — 0 is the old [vN] form, which every reader migrates
a whole number, digits only, as the site's port reads it too
a file that never said is a format-1 file: the format did not exist before it
the old [vN] placeholders, migrated on load by every reader
a newer client reads every older format (it migrates on load)
🔴 the case this rule exists for: loaded anyway, a format-1 client wrote the file back as format 1 and damaged it in silence
